Studio.heading: A space built around your story.
Studio.body: Ink Studio is a space for people who see a tattoo not just as an image, but as part of their own story. Artists of different styles work under one roof, with the same attention to detail in every session — and in the conversation that happens before the needle ever touches skin.

prepare.question: How do I prepare for a session?
prepare.answer: Get a good night's sleep, eat beforehand, and stay hydrated. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours before your appointment and wear comfortable clothing that gives easy access to the area.

duration.question: How long does a session take?
duration.answer: It depends entirely on size and detail — a small piece can take under an hour, while larger work is usually split across multiple sessions. We'll give you a realistic estimate during your consultation.

consultation.question: Can I come in for a consultation first?
consultation.answer: Yes — consultations are free and there's no obligation to book afterward. It's the easiest way to talk through placement, size, and style before committing.

chooseArtist.question: How do I choose an artist?
chooseArtist.answer: Browse the Artists and Works sections to see who works in the style you're drawn to. If you're unsure, mention it in your booking comment and we'll help point you in the right direction.

howBooking.question: How does booking work?
howBooking.answer: Pick a service and artist, choose an available date and time, and leave your contact details. You'll see a confirmation on screen right away, and we'll follow up to confirm the details.

cancel.question: How do I cancel a booking?
cancel.answer: Message us on Telegram or by phone with your name and appointment time, and we'll cancel it for you. Please give us as much notice as you can.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.body: Ink Studio is a demo/concept project built for a developer portfolio. It is not a real business, and this page does not describe the practices of an actual company. In a production deployment, this page would explain what data is collected through the booking form, how it is stored (via Supabase), and how visitors can request its removal.
